title: Provide a CodeGraph index in VIXEN lane worktrees
body: The mandated codegraph explore query failed with no .codegraph index in the capstatic worktree, so tracing active capability and pick paths required manual rg and source inspection. Provision or build a current index automatically for isolated VIXEN worktrees so the graph-first workflow works there.

title: Run VIXEN build presets from their nested source directory instead of the repository root
body: Running cmake --build --preset vixen-wsl-full from the VBVS--VIXEN repository root exited before starting CMake because CMakePresets.json is nested under VIXEN/. I had to rerun from VIXEN/ for the queued witness. Add a documented root wrapper or root preset forwarding entry so root-level build commands resolve the VIXEN presets consistently.
